language: Java 17 parent target; Maven multi-module reactor
linter: None enforced in the Maven build — Checkstyle, SonarLint and PMD are configured only in IntelliJ project files

namingConventions.endpoints: Unversioned plural resources such as /persons and /users
namingConventions.exceptions: *RuntimeException or *Exception carrying an i18n message key and numeric business code
namingConventions.tests: *.java under src/test/java, but the convention is mostly unused

documentationStandard: No API specification or service README was found; controller signatures and gateway routes are the de-facto contract
typeStrictness: Not applicable — no TypeScript; Java is statically typed
patterns: Prefer the established Spring Boot 2.7 javax.* APIs; do not introduce jakarta.* or Spring Boot 3 syntax without an approved framework migration
Constructor injection through Lombok @RequiredArgsConstructor and final fields is dominant
MapStruct 1.5.3 is the established mapper pattern, but is currently consumed through static Mappers.getMapper() singletons in user-service and person-service
DTO conversion normally happens at the controller boundary; request/response DTOs live in controller.dto or dto packages
Checked business exceptions carry an i18n message key plus a GlobalErrorCode and are translated by a @ControllerAdvice
RestTemplate is the only live inter-service HTTP client pattern; gateway-service uses reactive WebClient internally

Configuration is externalised for gateway-service, person-service, user-service and notification-service through Spring Cloud Config; auth-service, admin-service, account-service and config-service use local configuration
No OpenFeign, OpenAPI, bean validation, Flyway, Liquibase, Kafka or eventing dependency is active
conventions: Use one Maven module per independently deployable Spring Boot service
spring.application.name is the Consul service id and the Spring Cloud Config document name
Unversioned REST paths are current project convention; adding /api/v1 is an architectural change requiring approval
Keep Jackson default-property-inclusion NON_NULL unless a migration is planned
Do not copy credentials from existing YAML into new files or examples
When touching a module, correct source/target 10 drift toward the inherited Java 17 configuration rather than adding new module-level pins
constraints: P0 — live credentials are committed in several YAML and properties files; treat all src/main/resources/** values as secrets until rotated and externalized
auth-service is not an active authorization server: OAuth2/security/JPA/JJWT signing beans are commented out and login returns the literal string token
gateway-service is a token relay, not a JWT validator; its Spring Security, java-jwt and jjwt declarations are commented out
user-service currently uses anyRequest().permitAll(), so service-level authentication is not enforced
account-service is a non-running scaffold and must not be counted as a functional backend service
notification-service has no application endpoints and is a scheduler-driven SMTP job
Only two test classes exist across the repository and no CI enforces build quality
A Maven wrapper is committed in every module, contrary to the earlier Phase 3 note
Adding spring-boot-starter-validation, Flyway/Liquibase, SAS, Kafka, Prometheus, or a different client pattern requires dependency/pattern discussion

testing.policyNotes: Phase 6 user selection: recommended is the default TDD policy for new behavior, with pragmatic exceptions. TaskMaster usage remains complex-only.
testing.mockingStrategy: Mockito and Spring Boot test slices are available but largely unused
testing.notes: Two test classes were observed: a stale auth-service WebMvcTest referencing classes absent from its module, and a config-service contextLoads test that expects Consul. Effective automated coverage is near zero.

mainDefects: auth-service and gateway-service security/auth dependencies are commented out rather than deleted
user-service has duplicate /users/{id} and /users/{username} path patterns
user-service update() ignores its request body and login() returns null
person-service persists an unverified userId and has no request validation
admin-service remember-me uses a random key regenerated on every restart
notification-service has no send timeout, retry or idempotency guard

constraints.compliance: TBD — Phase 5 Q3 was skipped; no formal compliance standard has been selected
Personal PII is logged at INFO by person-service controller methods
TOTP secret is stored plaintext and second factor is never verified
Actuator endpoints are exposed with include "*" and no service security
Personal mail recipients are hard-coded in notification-service
projectSpecificNotes: Phase 4 analysis corrected the Phase 3 assumptions: Java 17 is the parent target but several modules pin compiler source/target to 10; no formatter/lint gate runs; MapStruct and Lombok dominate; validation and API specs are absent; auth and gateway authentication are dormant scaffolding; account is a scaffold and notification is a scheduler-only service.
